family_reports.body: The system ultimately failed my kids. My kids had to deal with years of harassment, lies, manipulation from their father, and the court still hasn’t held him accountable for it. Now myself and children are in therapy, I still have to make my 2 youngest go [redacted] with him. He lost custody of our oldest 1.5 years ago due to GAL recommendations. I’ve been put into financial hardships from paying for attorneys, therapists, and other fees only for him to get away with the horrible things he’s done. They don’t care about families. They care about lining their pockets.

System was complicit in alienating my children from me. Attorneys, GAL's, a Case Manager, Therapists, Judges, KVC. I have spent well over $150,000 over a two year period of time only to have two of my 3 children go no contact. No abuse, no drugs or addiction problems. All of this over screens and permissive parenting.
It had destroyed my children's mental health and mine. My youngest has became suicidal, which is everyday.

public_comments.comment_text: Ignored the domestic violence, Ignored the abuse that happened to my daughter that was done by her father, whom had charges in the same county. Ignored evidence. Allowed the derailing. Ignored that I had been a victim of domestic violence and all abuse done by the father many years and much more.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: She wouldn’t listen to me or my attorneys about the abuse, drugs, disregarded everything. Told me it was “almost legal” in Kansas when he was smoking & having drugs around our kids & told him to “put his stuff away”. She has let him continue to break court orders with no repercussions.
